description: Bitmap font from a TTF/OTF: atlas PNG, BMFont .fnt with kerning, JSON and a preview of a sample line. Pixel mode snaps glyphs to whole pixels with no antialiasing. Price: $0.10 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Font tools: Turn a TTF/OTF font into a bitmap font for games: crisp pixel-perfect glyphs for pixel art or smooth antialiased ones, Latin and Cyrillic, optional outline, atlas PNG plus AngelCode BMFont .fnt with kerning (Unity, Godot, Phaser, LibGDX) and JSON..

color.description: Glyph colour baked into the atlas (white lets the engine tint it).

font.description: TTF or OTF file as base64.

mode.description: pixel: crisp, no antialiasing, for pixel art games; smooth: antialiased.
